stories.title: Records reveal 3 other women accused Packers' Jacobs of abuse after arrest
stories.summary: Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against the Packers' Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.

stories.title: LeBron too much for Knicks late in what Nurse calls 'his best game' as 76er
stories.summary: LeBron James rescued Philadelphia late Friday night in what coach Nick Nurse called his best game as a Sixer.

stories.title: More Thunder woes: Holmgren out 8-10 weeks after knee procedure
stories.summary: Chet Holmgren will be out eight to 10 weeks because of a knee injury, the latest setback for an OKC team that lost Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace for an extended time early this week.

stories.title: Sources: Walter, Kushner finalize terms of Lakers sale at $12.5B valuation
stories.summary: Lakers owner Mark Walter and Thrive Capital founder Josh Kushner met Thursday to finalize the transaction and are expected to sign the formal agreement soon, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Sources: Kucherov requests trade; Lightning have 'no intention' of dealing him
stories.summary: Tampa Bay Lightning forward Nikita Kucherov, in the final year of his contract, has requested a trade, sources told ESPN Friday, but general manager Julien BriseBois said in a statement that the team has "no intention of trading" the star.
